brief: Prioritise outstanding remedial work affecting the unit's ability to shed heat before the event begins, in accordance with the hierarchy in SOP-016. Because this unit is of advanced age with a history of high loading and has a reduced margin against mechanical failure, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 if the unit cannot be attended before the event as outlined in MG-023. Record every de-rating applied along with its reason, value, and period as required by MG-021.
